name: authoring-patch-readiness-order
description: Stale checkpoints after a patch: on a draft that was inspected, validated and previewed, a successful edit_workflow_patch returns a `readiness` object in which inspect, validate and preview turn stale and approval is reported (auto mode needs none). save_workflow_draft's notes spell out the order inspect -> validate -> dry run -> save, so the next turns run the checks once, in sequence, instead of hitting nine save gates one by one.
failure_class: stale checkpoints after a patch without a readiness signal
